content: Koki-yap tutulu no' Babel
Ler de noh di mniotni de yawalli ida.
Noka rwaran pa rla'awa walli tipru, pa rlernana riwni-rai mtatanni la'a Sinear, noka rhol lia hande wa.
Lera ida rna'ohma pa idma nakot la ida: “Mai pia itsoi lieta-twatat ruhuna la'pa ttutin awru-tsaran watu.” Edon rnairi watu me smen pa rhi'a mere rnairi tanmiera nor tera.

Lera ida pa rna'ohma owa'ana riwra: “Mai pia tsoi lieta-twatat ruhuna, me itwatatu ili nhioli liarni me watu diena pidarni pa ntut lia lyanti pa itahak kota-nana, totpa it yana tdurmue'era-tsakrie'era it la noh di uhunu-ewatni-ewatni-lahwani.”
Noka Orgahi Nerun pa Namkeka letlawan dena me il tutullu-gen lolo'oni maka rimormiori rwatat nana.
Noka Nhar lirni: “Hari de hairi ida me yawala ida pa honona rnairia. Hadi de na'nama kniarni re yanullu, dodo'ondi, hya' maka ha rtetwiana-rtaiwian nana de, hota nla nlola, hadom edon ta'eni la' ira.
Nhi'p Iterun pa tiwru-tgora yawalli re, totpa idma edon rna'erit nan id yaltierni.”
Emkade pa Orgahi Ntiwrie'era-nhawrie'era rpa rokru noh di uhunu-ewatni-ewatni-lahwani, nhi'nande tulla-kniarni mana edonna ntutu-nte'ela honi.

Hade nariei pede, nmai wia dodo'ondi mana let de nanni de rweta de riwra Babel (nnia'eratni de, tiwru-tgora), yoma la' hande de Orgahi Ntiwrie'era-nhawrie'era rimormiori wokni-le'enu, ne ntaw hande pa Orgahi Ne'era-nhakra rla noh di uhunu-ewatni-ewatni-lahwani.
Sema duratni-waitni
Hadi de Sema duratni-waitni. La'pa Sema umarnu anni rahu id wa noma nayor niana Arpaksad, de anni wornu rlardoini la gera ktiowru-opli nhia'a.
Sema nmormior mia'ta pa anni rahu wolima, la'pa nayor niana Arpaksad pa nhorwua dewade nayor niana Arpaksad wuliodani patke'a rora muanke'a.
La'pa Arpaksad umarnu anni terampwotelu wehrani wolim wa, dewade nayor niana Sela.
Arpaksad nmormior niekpa aninni rahu wogata wehrani wotelu. La'pa nayor niana Sela pa nhorwua dewade, nayor niana Sela wuliodani patke'a rora muanke'a.
La'pa Sela umarnu anni terampwotel wua dewade, nayor niana Eber.
Sela nmormior mia'ta pa aninni rahu wogata wehrani wotelu. La'pa nayor niana Eber pa nhorwua dewade, nayor niana Eber wuliodani patke'a rora muanke'a.
La'pa Eber umarnu anni terampwotelu wehrani wogat wa dewade, nayor niana Peleg.
Eber nmormior niekpa aninni rahu wogata terampwotelu. La'pa nayor niana Peleg pa nhorwua, dewade nayor niana Peleg wuliodani patke'a rora muanke'a.
La'pa Peleg umarnu anni terampwotel wua dewade, nayor niana Rehu.
Peleg nmormior niekpa aninni rahu woru wehrani wosiewa. La'pa nayor niana Rehu, dewade nayor niana Rehu wuliodani patke'a rora muanke'a.
La'pa Rehu umarnu anni terampwotelu wehrani wor wua dewade, nayor niana Serug.
Rehu nmormior niekpa aninni rahu woru wehrani wo'itu. La'pa nayor niana Serug pa nhorwua dewade, nayor niana Serug wuliodani patke'a rora muanke'a.
La'pa Serug umarnu anni terampwotel wua dewade nayor niana Nahor.
Serug nmormior niekpa aninni rahu woru. La'pa nayor niana Nahor pa nhorwua, dewade nayor niana Nahor wuliodani patke'a rora muanke'a.
La'pa Nahor umarnu anni terampworu wehrani wosiew pa dewade, nayor niana Terah.
Nahor nmormior mia'ta pa aninni rahu ida termida wehrani wosiewa. La'pa nayor niana Terah pa nhorwua dewade, nayor niana Terah wuliodani patke'a rora muanke'a.
La'pa Terah umarnu anni terampwo'it wua de nayor nian Abram, Nahor nora Haran.
Terah duratni-waitni horatni
Hadi de Terah duratni-waitni. Terah nayor niana Haran, Abram, nora Nahor, ne Haran nayor niana Lot.
La'pa Terah nmormior mia'ta de Haran, Terah a'nani yanulu nmat tiar lia leta Ur, geni miaka Kasdima rdella, me leta maka rmor tiarga Haran la.
Abram nor Sarai rmehlima me, Nahor nor hyalli yanulu Haran a'nani patke'a nanni Milka rmehlima. Milka elli de, Yiska.
Sarai di nkerna (nakleha a'na).

Noka Terah nodia Abram nora hawni Sarai me hyalli a'nani Lot pa rla'awa. Rla'awa pa rewre'wa rto'or doinia leta Ur, gen miaka Kasdim rdella pa totpa rla'awa Kana'an lowanni, mere edon rodi liarni, ne rte'ela' leta Haran, noma rholi hande wa.
Terah umarnu anni rahu woru wehrani wolima, noka nmat tiar lia Haran.
